instruction: Fan out the four pads of the QFN-8 placed at `(50, 50)` mm on `/home/user/Desktop/qfn_board.brd`, and save the board as `/home/user/Desktop/fanout.brd`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/fanout.brd` parses as well-formed XML. 2. Exactly 4 new `<wire>` elements have been added relative to the starter, each associated with one of those four pads. 3. Exactly 4 new `<via>` elements have been added, one per fan-out. 4. Each new wire/via pair stays attached to the same pad, and all four side-facing pads of the package are used exactly once. 5. The `U1` / `QFN8` element is still present. 6. The total `<element>` count is unchanged. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
